verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL is documented as running "directly on your data lake" with ANSI SQL plus Delta Lake extensions, letting you build warehouses "without moving your data." Delta tables are further supported through time travel and streaming sources and sinks, so the core idea of querying open-format lake data in place is evidenced for Delta. A community report notes that Unity Catalog external volumes must match the workspace's cloud provider, which limits cross-cloud object-storage access. missing for 10: any evidence of querying Iceberg tables, explicit evidence of querying raw Parquet files in object storage in place, independent hands-on corroboration.
